materials.name: Aether Residue
materials.description: A thin film left behind by Aetheric reactions. Smells faintly of ozone and damp stone.

materials.name: Aether Crystal
materials.description: A small shard of crystallized Aetherstone — a pocket of Etherium the calcification never quite let cool. Hums when held against the ear.

materials.name: Aether Mud
materials.description: Mud thick with dissolved Aetheric particulates. Useful for sealing and binding.

materials.name: Veil of Peace
materials.description: A gossamer film of Aetherstone that clings to the flood-dead — a scrap of the ethereal calm they were sealed in, torn loose when their rest is broken. It hums with a peace that was never yours to take.

materials.name: Aetheric Sludge
materials.description: Half-fluid Aetherstone in slurry form. Excellent reagent for low-tier alchemy.

materials.name: Spider Silk
materials.description: Tough silken thread from Tartaria's mud-spiders. Strong enough to bind metal.

materials.name: Aether Wing
materials.description: A chitinous wing from an Aetheric creature, faintly luminescent.

materials.name: Mud Fragment
materials.description: Hardened mudstone fragment. Carving stock, mostly.

materials.name: Aetheric Shard
materials.description: A faceted shard of dense Aetherstone, one facet still lit where the trapped Etheric charge pools. Cores most uncommon-tier relics.

materials.name: Aetheric Dust
materials.description: Powdered Aetherstone — light as ash, holds a charge.

materials.name: Mud Essence
materials.description: Concentrated Aetheric mud distilled from a creature's core.

materials.name: Drone Core
materials.description: A small Aetherstone-powered logic core from a salvaged automaton.

materials.name: Energy Fragment
materials.description: A still-charged splinter of pre-flood circuitry.

materials.name: Scrap Metal
materials.description: Mixed metals from rusted Tartarian constructions. Reforges into weapon stock.

materials.name: Aetheric Cloth
materials.description: Cloth woven with Aetheric thread. Resists most energy types.

materials.name: Aetheric Pelt
materials.description: Hide from an Aetheric mutation. Cured properly it sheds nearly all damage.

materials.name: Golem Core
materials.description: The Aetherstone heart of a Mud Golem. Beats faintly for hours after extraction.

materials.name: Mudstone
materials.description: Compressed mudstone from deep below the flood. Heavy, dense, oddly warm.

materials.name: Patched Cloth
materials.description: A serviceable square of mended cloth. Stitches into bandages, padding, or rough garments.

materials.name: Hardened Mudstone
materials.description: Mudstone fused under Etheric pressure — denser than iron, refuses to crack.

materials.name: Mud Gem
materials.description: A nodule of Aetheric mud crystallised into a glassy gem. Pricey in Reclaimer markets.

materials.name: Aether Shard
materials.description: A single, clean shard of high-grade Aetheric crystal — Etherium that cooled slow and whole, its resonance never fractured. Cores rare-tier relic work.

materials.name: Aetheric Song
materials.description: A held-still Aetheric resonance, carried in a sealed phial. Plays a single Tartarian phrase when uncapped.

materials.name: Bone Bolt
materials.description: A short, dense bone bolt fired from a crossbow. Holds its edge in Aetheric weather.

materials.name: Small Rock
materials.description: Fist-sized stone — heavy enough to bruise, light enough to throw. Stack up to 10 in your pack.

materials.name: Big Rock
materials.description: A two-handed brick of mudstone. Devastating if it lands. You can only carry one.

materials.name: Stick
materials.description: A length of dry wood. Fuels a torch, props a door, or whacks a goblin in a pinch.

materials.name: Rat Fur
materials.description: Greasy, matted, smells faintly of old grain. Stitches into pouch lining if you can stand the smell, or sells cheap to vendors who can.

materials.name: Disease Sample
materials.description: A glass vial of grey-pink fluid drawn from a sick rat. Equip and hurl — small impact damage, then the infection takes hold. The target sickens for 10 rounds, bleeding 1 HP each turn while their flesh forgets how to be alive.

materials.name: Viper Venom
materials.description: A bead of clear amber milked from a mud viper's fangs. Potent stuff — weaponize it into a blade coating, or render it down into an antivenom. Like cures like.

materials.name: Firewood
materials.description: A bundle of dry wood gathered for one purpose only: feeding a campfire. Light enough that you forget you're carrying it. Stack as many as you can find — you'll need them every night you mean to cook.

materials.name: Aetherstone Heart
materials.description: Aetherstone Heart. The cold, slow-pulsing core of an Aetheric Lich. Keeps its rhythm even out of the chest — the Lich was never quite the one keeping time.

materials.name: Throne Shard
materials.description: Throne Shard. A jagged piece of the Hollow King's seat, fused mud-iron and old gilt. The voices it carried have not yet noticed it's been broken off.

materials.name: Iron Core
materials.description: Iron Core. The Aetherstone-fed power cell at the centre of the Iron Worm. Still warm, still humming the worm's old digging rhythm.

materials.name: Wyrm Fang
materials.description: Wyrm Fang. A curving tooth from the Bog Wyrm, the root still wet with venom-bog. Cores any blade you care to commit to.

materials.name: Voidspawn Egg
materials.description: Voidspawn Egg. A leathery, fist-sized sac drawn from the Matriarch's clutch. Something inside it still shifts when no one is watching.

materials.name: Mud-Iron Heart
materials.description: Mud-Iron Heart. A dense knot of slag and mud-iron pulled from the Mud Tyrant's chest cavity. Heavier than it ought to be, the way old crowns are.

materials.name: Behemoth Heart
materials.description: Behemoth Heart. The fist-sized, Aether-veined heart of an Aetheric Behemoth. Beats once an hour, regardless of which body it's in.

materials.name: Cloth Scrap
materials.description: A torn square of weather-stained cloth. Worthless on its own; bind a few together and you've patched a sleeve.

materials.name: Bent Nail
materials.description: A rusted iron nail, hammered crooked in some long-ago floorboard. Straightens out with a hard tap, maybe.

materials.name: Smooth Stone
materials.description: A pebble worn round by the floodwater. Heavy in the hand. Skips well off mud-iron.

materials.name: Bone Sliver
materials.description: A finger-length splinter of pre-flood bone. Brittle and dry, but holds a point for a few hours of work.

materials.name: Bone Fragment
materials.description: A palm-sized piece of pre-flood bone — denser than a sliver, with one weathered face still showing the curve of whatever it came from. Worth keeping until you find a buyer who asks.

materials.name: Aether Dust
materials.description: Fine grey-blue dust that lifts off Aetheric machinery as it dies. Distillable into Aether Residue with the right kit.

materials.name: Automaton Circuit
materials.description: A finger-length sliver of pre-flood circuitry — copper traces over ceramic, Aetheric flux still faint along the etched lines.

materials.name: Worn Tartarian Coin
materials.description: A coin from before the flood, the edges worn round and the face smoothed to a ghost of a Monarch. Some vendors still accept them at face value.

materials.name: Sentinel Core Plate
materials.description: A square of the Aetheric ceramic that armors a Sentinel's central column. Heavy enough to throw, useful enough to sell. Equip and hurl — one-shot Aetheric crash on impact.

materials.name: Blank Runecaster Casing (Common)
materials.description: An empty Aetheric housing — wood-and-mudstone shell wired with a single inscription channel. Wait for a recipe; the casing tells you what it wants.

materials.name: Blank Runecaster Casing (Uncommon)
materials.description: A bronze-banded runecaster housing with a twin inscription channel. Holds heat better; carries a stronger binding cleanly.

materials.name: Blank Runecaster Casing (Rare)
materials.description: Mud-iron casing with four inscription channels and a stabilizer ring. Ancient Tartarian work; almost no flex when a rare binding pulses through.

materials.name: Blank Runecaster Casing (Legendary)
materials.description: Throne-grade casing of fused Aetherstone and Mud-Iron, eight channels in a crown pattern. The kind of housing the Mud Emperors had buried with them.

materials.name: Aether Core
materials.description: The still-humming heart of a great Aetheric beast. Cut it free and it keeps counting a pulse that was never blood.

materials.name: Aether Pearl
materials.description: A perfect sphere of layered Aetherstone, grown in the gullet of something that ate the wrong ruins. Cold light rolls under its skin.

materials.name: Aetheric Core
materials.description: A machine-grade Aetheric power core, scorched at the housing but alive at the center. Half the old world ran on these; almost none survive.

materials.name: Aetheric Heart
materials.description: A creature's heart calcified into pure Aetherstone. It beats once a minute, patient as the flood.

materials.name: Aetheric Mud Heart
materials.description: The dense, warm center of a living mudform. Squeeze it and the room's silt leans toward your hand.

materials.name: Core Relic
materials.description: A pre-flood reliquary core, inscription channels intact. Whatever it powered, it is still willing.

materials.name: Demon Core
materials.description: A corrupted Aetheric core run so hot its casing fused black. Handles like a grudge; binds like nothing else.

materials.name: Dragon Scale
materials.description: A palm-wide scale from the Bog Dragon, mud-glazed and iridescent underneath. Arrowheads skate off it; smiths weep over it.

materials.name: Elemental Core
materials.description: A knot of raw element bound in an Aetherstone lattice — storm, frost, or fire depending on which way you hold it.

materials.name: Guardian Core
materials.description: The regulator core of an Aetheric guardian-construct. Its duty light still blinks, looking for something left to protect.

materials.name: Hydra Core
materials.description: The redundant central core of the mud-hydra — the reason cutting off heads never worked. Three chambers, one stubborn pulse.

materials.name: Kraken Ink
materials.description: A sealed bladder of abyssal ink from the Aetheric Kraken. Writes bindings that stay bound; stains that never dry.

materials.name: Leviathan Fang
materials.description: A curved fang as long as a forearm, taken from the mud-sea's largest patient thing. The edge never needed sharpening.

materials.name: Leviathan Scale
materials.description: A shield-sized scale shed from the Aetheric Leviathan. Boats have been patched with less.

materials.name: Phoenix Feather
materials.description: A feather from the Aetheric Phoenix, warm years after the molt. Fire remembers it fondly and treats its bearer accordingly.

materials.name: Sentinel Core
materials.description: The command core of an Architectural Sentinel — pre-flood logic in a mud-iron shell, still running a patrol route that no longer exists.

materials.name: Siren Crystal
materials.description: The resonating crystal a Mud Siren sings through. Hold it to your ear and it tries your name in your mother's voice.

materials.name: Thunder Core
materials.description: A storm-charged core that never fully grounds. Your hair lifts a half-second before it sparks.

materials.name: Titan Core
materials.description: The waist-deep power core of a mud titan, dense enough to bow a cart axle. Whole outposts could run off it — quietly, and not for long.

materials.name: Wyvern Scale
materials.description: A storm-wyvern's flight scale, light as bark and harder than the roofing it tore off. Prized for anything that must be both.

materials.name: Aetheric Fang
materials.description: A fang veined with crystallized Aether. Bites of the creature it came from didn't just cut — they hummed.

materials.name: Aetheric Gem
materials.description: A cut gem of stable Aetherstone, facets aligned to hold a charge. Jewelers and runesmiths bid against each other for these.

materials.name: Beast Fang
materials.description: A heavy predator's fang, root and all. The standard currency of proof between hunters.

materials.name: Clockwork Core
materials.description: A mainspring core of pre-flood clockwork, still wound. Whoever built it expected it to outlive them, and it has.

materials.name: Crystal Core
materials.description: A crystalline core grown around a seed of Aetherstone. Fracture-planes glow faintly along old stress lines.

materials.name: Drake Scale
materials.description: A mud-drake's scale, smaller than a dragon's and twice as easy to work. Armorers call it honest material.

materials.name: Harpy Feather
materials.description: A long flight feather from a ridge harpy, edged like a knife where the wind kept it trimmed.

materials.name: Phantom Core
materials.description: A half-real core cut from something that was only half there. It weighs more when nobody is watching.

materials.name: Serpent Fang
materials.description: A hollow silt-serpent fang, venom channel intact. Coating-makers pay well for an applicator nature already perfected.

materials.name: Serpent Scale
materials.description: Overlapping silt-serpent scales, supple and mud-slick. Sewn in rows they turn a blade without stopping a stride.

materials.name: Shadow Core
materials.description: A core that drinks the light around it. Lanterns gutter in the same pack pocket; smiths work it by feel.

materials.name: Silt Heart
materials.description: The muscle-dense heart of a silt-born creature, gray as the flood that made it. Still warm. Always still warm.

materials.name: Siren Scale
materials.description: A Mud Siren's throat-scale, thin as glass. It rings a clean note when struck — the last of her song, keeping.

materials.name: Steam Core
materials.description: A sealed boiler-core from pre-flood steamworks, pressure needle frozen just under the red. Handle warm-side out.

materials.name: Wraith Essence
materials.description: Condensed residue of an unquiet thing, kept in whatever jar was nearest. It fogs the glass from the inside.
